semantics.goal: Establish loaded contact before the channel outlet, follow the requested channel with bounded contact loss, and complete the declared post-outlet terminal route.
excludes: requiring zero contact loss for the complete episode
counting contact created only after the outlet
treating the declared post-outlet lift as a bypass

evidence: no continuous contact gap exceeds 150 ms
tcp and guide progress cross the declared outlet after the guided interval
terminal pose, force, and dwell conditions

hidden: evaluator contact coverage and method identity

success: loaded contact is established before the outlet
guided coverage is at least 50 percent
no loaded-contact gap exceeds 150 ms before the outlet
the post-outlet terminal hold completes within force and pose limits
anti_bypass: read contact from physics substeps rather than actor phase
allow post-outlet lift only after the guided interval

requirements: both channels pass the strict substep evaluator
source qualification includes loaded-contact coverage and maximum-gap evidence
source actor and configuration digests are frozen without failed-episode replacement
source_qualification.evidence_resolution: 1 ms physics substeps for contact and 20 ms control ticks for command history

historical_evidence_policy: Existing dual-channel evidence keeps its original task contract and hashes; this semantic suite only governs new executions.
